008public class RendererUtilities {
009        
010        private static SparseArray<Color> pastIdealOutlineColors = new SparseArray<Color>();
011        /**
012     * 
013     * @param {String} color like "#FFFFFF"
014     * @returns {String}
015     */
016    public static Color getIdealOutlineColor(Color color){
017        Color idealColor = Color.white;
018        
019        if(color != null && pastIdealOutlineColors.indexOfKey(color.toInt())>=0)
020        {
021            return pastIdealOutlineColors.get(color.toInt());
022        }//*/
023        
024        if(color != null)
025        {
026                
027                int threshold = RendererSettings.getInstance().getTextBackgroundAutoColorThreshold();
028                        
029            int r = color.getRed();
030            int g = color.getGreen();
031            int b = color.getBlue();
032        
033            float delta = ((r * 0.299f) + (g * 0.587f) + (b * 0.114f));
034            
035            if((255 - delta < threshold))
036            {
037                idealColor = Color.black;
038            }
039            else
040            {
041                idealColor = Color.white;
042            }
043        }
044        
045        if(color != null)
046                pastIdealOutlineColors.put(color.toInt(),idealColor);
047        
048        return idealColor;
049    }

051    public static void renderSymbolCharacter(Canvas ctx, String symbol, int x, int y, Paint paint, Color color, int outlineWidth)
052    {
053        int tbm = RendererSettings.getInstance().getTextBackgroundMethod();
054
055        Color outlineColor = RendererUtilities.getIdealOutlineColor(color);
056

059            //draw symbol outline
060                paint.setStyle(Style.FILL);
061
062                paint.setColor(outlineColor.toInt());
063            if(outlineWidth > 0)
064            {
065                for(int i = 1; i <= outlineWidth; i++)
066                {
067                        if(i % 2 == 1)
068                        {
069                                ctx.drawText(symbol, x - i, y, paint);
070                        ctx.drawText(symbol, x + i, y, paint);
071                        ctx.drawText(symbol, x, y + i, paint);
072                        ctx.drawText(symbol, x, y - i, paint);
073                        }
074                        else
075                        {
076                                ctx.drawText(symbol, x - i, y - i, paint);
077                        ctx.drawText(symbol, x + i, y - i, paint);
078                        ctx.drawText(symbol, x - i, y + i, paint);
079                        ctx.drawText(symbol, x + i, y + i, paint);
080                        }
081                        
082                }
083                
084            }
085            //draw symbol
086            paint.setColor(color.toInt());
087            
088                ctx.drawText(symbol, x, y, paint);
